title: Zesty Jamaican Beef Skewers
description: A crowd-pleasing Jamaican dish featuring crispy beef skewers with a mustardy flavor, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill, served with a side of spicy sauce. This recipe is a dash-friendly and easy-to-make dish that is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together beef stock concentrate, brown sugar, soy sauce, grated ginger, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Add the beef pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the skewers are grilling, mix together yellow mustard and scotch bonnet peppers in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are done, brush them with the mustard mixture and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro and a side of spicy sauce.
